data.narrative:
Atmos Space Cargo is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Sebastian Klaus, Marta Oliveira, Jeffrey Hendrikse, and Christian Grimm, having raised €30M to date. The broader Space & Aerospace sector comprises 6 public comparables (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs, though few are directly comparable at the Series A stage.

Valuation analysis relies on a single applicable method: stage-progression analysis, which applies a typical 2.0x step-up multiplier to the €30M total raised as a proxy for current value, implying a €60M valuation. This multiplier reflects observed progression from Series A to subsequent funding rounds in the space sector. Peer-median analysis is not applicable due to insufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables (0 same-stage, 2 adjacent-stage identified). Public-comp anchoring using the Space & Aerospace median P/S of 23.9x cannot be applied in the absence of disclosed target revenue, which is typical for private companies at this stage.

The analysis supports a valuation range of €51M to €69M, with a median of €60M. Given reliance on a single method, material uncertainty surrounds this estimate. Key sensitivities include the applicability of the 2.0x step-up assumption to Atmos's specific market position and capital efficiency relative to peer progression patterns. Additional revenue or profitability data would enable public-comp anchoring and narrow the range materially.
